Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 86. Category: form. Super Saiyan Berserk.

Transformation
Your true power has been unleashed and oddly
enough it finally feels natural. You’re brilliant emerald
eyes and hair shine with an almost unceasing brilliance.
Increase your Power by 4
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You deal an additional 1d8 to all damage
You gain an additional +2 to your AC.
You gain +2 Bulk
At the end of your turn, you lose 5 Stamina
Gained at Level 20
